g.aria-label: FSDP Communication Tax: 3 Collective Phases = 1.5× DDP Traffic
t_comm(FSDP) = 3(k−1)/k · S · β_link (grows from 1.5 S at k=2 → 3 S as k → ∞)
Memory per GPU drops as 16N / k, while bytes sent per GPU grow with k!
Tip: bf16 collective comm halves S_comm → 1.5(k−1)/k · S (25% less than fp32 DDP!).
